title: company-brain-deploy compatibility pins
description: Immutable pin set for Portal images, Hermes runtime, client-core seed, and relay contract major. No live git branches.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema major; bump only with breaking field changes.

web.description: Optional static SPA pin (portal-web tarball). Preferred over a web runtime container.

version.description: Immutable release label (e.g. v0.1.0). Not a git branch.

url.description: s3:// or https:// portal-web.tar.gz object URL.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes.

repository.description: Image repository without mutable tag as the sole pin.

tag.description: Optional human label; digest is authoritative.

version.description: Immutable release label (e.g. v0.1.0). Not a git branch.

url.description: s3:// or https:// artifact object URL. Prefer arch-labeled keys (…/linux-x86_64/…); unlabeled hermes/<version>/… is deprecated once labeled objects exist.

arch.description: Runtime platform label (product TARGET_ARCH / hermes.target_arch). Default product linux-x86_64. Maps to pins v2 backend.arch and Terraform backend_artifact_arch.

target_arch.description: Alias of arch (product workflow pin echo). Prefer arch in new files; either maps to backend.arch on v2 translation.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes (maps to HERMES_ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_B64).

version.description: Immutable release label. Not a git branch.

url.description: s3:// or https:// artifact object URL.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes (maps to CLIENT_CORE_ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_B64).

major.description: Hermes relay connector contract major version.

artifact_attestation.description: Optional Ed25519 publisher attestation (openssl). SHA-256 pins remain required.

alg.description: Signature algorithm; only ed25519 is implemented offline via openssl pkeyutl.

signing_pubkey_b64.description: Base64 of PEM public key (maps to ARTIFACT_SIGNING_PUBKEY_B64).

signing_identity.description: Optional human label for the release key (maps to ARTIFACT_SIGNING_IDENTITY).

require.description: When true, map to REQUIRE_ARTIFACT_ATTESTATION=1 (fail-closed if sig/pubkey missing).
